baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ... يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ ... مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ
baseline_models.mechanism: Height, graded order, and throne establish sovereign control; that control becomes action when a command-bearing spirit is cast onto a chosen dependent, converting hierarchy into delegated warning.

activation_trace.role: High rank supplies the upper pole of the commission's vertical order.
Taking degree by degree makes the hierarchy an ordered channel rather than a single height.
The elevated royal seat identifies the source as governing authority.
Casting supplies the directional transfer from sovereign source onto the recipient.
Command makes the transferred spirit an authorization or charge, not an ownerless impulse.
Submissive service defines the recipient as dependent while enabling delegated action.
Fear-awakening warning is the commission's stated output.

changed_reading.before: A sequence of divine titles followed by the bestowal of revelation on a messenger.
changed_reading.after: The titles define a delivery architecture: elevated sovereignty sends an authorized, animating charge through a selected servant until it becomes warning.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root ل ق ي occurs in يُلْقِى and ٱلتَّلَاقِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One root spans an asymmetrical present act and a reciprocal future event: what is cast now prepares the servant and hearers for the encounter later.

activation_trace.role: The present pole is a one-way casting or placing.
The future pole is two sides arriving face to face.
The day as a severe event gives the encounter an eventful rather than merely calendrical force.

changed_reading.before: Casting the spirit and the Day of Meeting are two unrelated clauses.
changed_reading.after: The repeated root forms a temporal hinge: a message is placed into history now so that the later face-to-face convergence is not met unwarned.

baseline_models.mechanism: Spirit can be life and moving air, while the same casting root includes imparting and receiving speech; the deposited life-current therefore becomes voiced warning through the servant.

activation_trace.role: Life-bearing spirit supplies animation rather than bare information.
Wind and breath supply a mobile medium that can pass from source through a speaker.
Imparting and receiving speech connects the spirit's arrival to communicable wording.
Making news public supplies the outward broadcast stage.
The broadcast is functionally aimed at waking caution.

changed_reading.before: Spirit is an unspecified heavenly item bestowed on a recipient.
changed_reading.after: Spirit is also readable as a vivifying, breath-like transmission that becomes receivable speech and then public warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first delivers a written book downward, then immediately before the focus sends sky-provision downward to one who turns back. Together with spirit as wind, life, and vegetative renewal, this revises the courtly dispatch into a provision-like descent that must be received and made fruitful.

activation_trace.role: Wind gives the spirit a mobile, descending medium.
Vegetative breaking-forth supplies the possible fruit of the descent in its recipient.
Sending down and delivering establishes textual revelation as the first downward gift.
Ordered letters keep the descent tied to articulated communication.
A second delivered descent places provision directly beside the focus ayah.
Rain descending as provision supplies an ecological analogy for spirit reaching and reviving a servant.
Repeated return supplies the receptive turn by which the descent becomes remembrance.

structural_cues: 40:2 opens the surah with a descent from God; 40:13 repeats descent from the sky immediately before 40:15.
40:13 links signs, provision, remembrance, and turning, so reception rather than mere arrival matters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two descents, rain-like provision, turning, and spirit's wind and growth images; I infer that provision models how spirit takes effect. A live alternative is that the parallel is only directional and the spirit remains wholly propositional revelation.

changed_reading.before: A royal command is transmitted from above.
changed_reading.after: The command also descends like apportioned rain: it reaches a receptive servant as communicative provision capable of animating, growing, and warning.

context_deltas.mechanism: The three ayat after the focus unpack the meeting as forced emergence into an uncovered field, collapse of rival ownership, itemized recompense, and an event already drawing near.

activation_trace.role: Face-to-face convergence supplies the event being unpacked.
A severe happening makes the meeting a decisive event.
Emergence and uncovering make every participant publicly present.
The negated hiding removes private shelter from the encounter.
Sole kingship determines who controls the exposed assembly.
Matching deed with consequence gives the meeting an adjudicative operation.
Counting and reckoning make each exposed history computable.
Nearness turns the account from remote doctrine into approaching pressure.

structural_cues: 40:16-18 directly follows the focus and repeats both day-language and the imperative to warn.
The sequence moves from public emergence, to recompense without injustice, to bodily constriction as the event approaches.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exposure, no hiding, sole kingship, recompense, reckoning, and nearness; I treat these as mechanics of ٱلتَّلَاقِ rather than adjacent themes. The meeting can still retain the broader sense of assembly.

changed_reading.before: The Day of Meeting is a general future gathering.
changed_reading.after: It is compelled face-to-face exposure in which hidden histories become countable, rival ownership ends, and deeds meet their corresponding consequences.

context_deltas.mechanism: A believer inside Pharaoh's household moves from concealed faith to sustained public guidance. This activates the open wording 'whomever He wills among His servants' as warning agency that can surface from an unexpected social location, not only from an already visible office.

activation_trace.role: Will attached to a particular object keeps recipient selection open.
Service, rather than public rank, is the named recipient category.
Warning that wakes caution defines the selected servant's public function.
Heart-settling assent identifies the insider as a believer before his warning speech unfolds.
Concealment marks the socially unexpected location from which warning emerges.
Gentle indication toward the true road turns private belief into public guidance.
Straight direction against error specifies the content of the insider's guidance.

structural_cues: 40:28 names a believing man from Pharaoh's family who had concealed his faith, then gives him direct speech.
Across 40:28-38 he repeatedly addresses 'my people,' fears days of judgment for them, and invites them to follow a right path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belief, concealment, emergence into speech, and guidance; I infer that this character instantiates the social openness of 'whomever He wills among His servants.' It does not establish that he directly received ٱلرُّوحَ or held prophetic office; he may instead be a downstream responder.

changed_reading.before: The chosen servant is assumed to be only the already identified formal messenger.
changed_reading.after: The wording also leaves room for warning to be activated in a concealed believer inside a hostile institution, distributing commissioned speech beyond obvious public rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pharaoh constructs a high building and seeks connections by which to climb, inspect, and seize certainty about the God of Moses. Against this attempted upward capture, the focus defines true height operationally: the throne-holder is known by freely casting command downward, not by being reached through engineered elevation.

activation_trace.role: High rank anchors the contrast in the focus ayah's own elevation language.
Royal sovereignty distinguishes genuine rule from Pharaoh's architectural performance.
Casting downward makes height productive through outgoing agency.
The high constructed building supplies counterfeit, mechanically acquired elevation.
Reaching a goal supplies Pharaoh's attempted upward endpoint.
A rope or connective means materializes the imagined route to the heavens.
The repeated connective means extends the attempted route into the next ayah.
What is above and overshadows supplies the domain Pharaoh tries to penetrate.
An elevated approach supplies the attempted climb and inspection.

structural_cues: 40:36-37 pairs a ruler's command to build upward with his desire to reach heavenly means and inspect Moses' God.
The attempt ends in decorated bad action, obstruction from the path, and ruin rather than access.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the tower, attempted reach, heavenly connections, and ascent; I supply the directional contrast that genuine authority sends while counterfeit authority tries to seize by climbing. The episode may also function more narrowly as exposure of Pharaoh's skepticism.

changed_reading.before: God's high degrees and throne primarily locate Him at the top of a cosmic hierarchy.
changed_reading.after: Height chiefly names unseizable agency: the true sovereign reaches servants by sending command downward, while built ascent cannot capture or authenticate Him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The late creation sequence moves a human through measured, irreversible states from material origin to gestation, childhood, maturity, old age, death, and a named term. It activates 'degrees' as temporal development under the life-giver, so the spirit-warning enters a finite life-course before its terminal meeting.

activation_trace.role: Taking degree after degree supplies the focus anchor for staged development.
Life-bearing spirit places the commission within an animate life-course.
Bringing creation into being initiates the staged sequence.
A minute fluid origin supplies an early material degree.
A pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies the next dependent degree.
The small newborn marks emergence into a visible human stage.
Reaching a limit links maturity and the final appointed endpoint.
Taking the life closes some courses before every listed stage is traversed.
A fixed temporal limit gives the developmental ladder a terminal boundary.
Animate life confirms that the stages remain governed by the life-giver.

structural_cues: 40:67 uses repeated ثُمَّ to order dust, drop, clinging stage, child, maturity, old age, death, and appointed term.
40:68 immediately compresses that sequence into giving life, causing death, and effective command.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit temporal sequence and the focus branch supplies stepwise degrees; I map the sequence back onto ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ as life stages. Static ranks remain a live and stronger lexical alternative.

changed_reading.before: The degrees are fixed heights or ranks possessed by the throne-holder.
changed_reading.after: They also name the staged trajectories He raises creatures through; spirit-warning arrives during a bounded human course to orient it toward the final encounter.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus sends spirit from God's command or affair to a servant. Later the servant entrusts his own affair back to God and is protected; divine command then appears as effective speech, while messenger action remains bounded by permission. Commission is therefore a two-way but asymmetric circuit of entrustment, authorization, action, and return.

activation_trace.role: Affair or state permits the relational reading that will be mirrored by the servant's affair.
Binding command preserves the unequal authority within the exchange.
Returning an affair to another in reliance reverses the focus ayah's initial direction.
The servant's own affair forms the lexical mirror of the divine affair or command.
Divine seeing makes entrusted service supervised rather than abandoned.
The repeated servant category ties the returning affair to the focus recipient.
Protection supplies the contextual result of entrusting the affair.
Effective completion makes divine command perform rather than merely advise.
Occurrence in time supplies the realized endpoint of the spoken command.
Permission sets a boundary around what a messenger may produce.
The arriving divine command retains final initiative.
Decisive judgment marks the command's terminal exercise of authority.

structural_cues: 40:44-45 moves from the believer's entrusting his affair to divine sight and protection.
40:68 presents command as speech that immediately occurs; 40:78 denies autonomous signs to messengers and reserves the arriving command and judgment to God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored occurrences of 'affair,' effective command, permission, and protection; I infer a governed exchange rather than one-way possession. The materially live alternative is polysemy: 'His command' and 'my affair' may remain distinct senses with no reciprocal circuit.

changed_reading.before: Spirit descends as a one-way grant of power to an autonomous charismatic agent.
changed_reading.after: The servant receives a licensed charge, returns his own affair in reliance, acts under divine sight, and never controls the command's efficacy or timing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The spirit-borne warning is an effective call placed before the meeting. The surah later names a Day of mutual calling, shows calls in punishment failing, and ends with belief no longer benefiting after force is seen. Warning therefore opens a response window that the encounter closes.

activation_trace.role: Publicizing news supplies the warning's pre-encounter broadcast.
Moving air supplies a contained image for the warning's carried voice.
Awakening caution defines the useful call while response remains possible.
The eventual encounter supplies the closing boundary.
Raised voice activates the Day of Calling as an acoustic counterpart to warning.
The second mapped call branch preserves the day as a field of elevated voices.
Calling by speech now fails to incline events or produce rescue.
Negated benefit states that late belief has lost practical efficacy.
An established recurring path makes closure of the window a stable rule.
Elapsed generations extend that rule through prior time.

structural_cues: 40:32 calls the feared event the Day of Calling; 40:49-50 stages pleas and calls after entry into punishment.
40:84-85 places professed belief after sight of force and explicitly denies it benefit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, later mutual calls, failed calls, and useless late belief; I infer that the warning's purpose is to preserve a usable interval before encounter. A narrower alternative treats these as separate scenes joined only by judgment.

changed_reading.before: To warn of the Day means to announce frightening future content.
changed_reading.after: The warning is a timed, answerable call: spirit opens communication before the Day becomes a cacophony of ineffective calls and direct encounter ends response.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 40:15 never says the servant 'carries' the spirit. It remains anchored in the spirit being cast upon a servant and in the surah's repeated literal carriers of throne and humans; downstream prose should present it only as a material relay analogy, not as a lexical gloss or claim about mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ ... عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ

activation_trace.role: Casting onto another supplies the first transfer in the proposed relay.
Life-bearing spirit is the nonmaterial load transferred to the servant.
The serving recipient becomes the possible middle carrier rather than the source.
Warning is the load's outward delivery to further recipients.
Bearing a visible load supplies the first literal carrier structure.
The royal throne itself appears within a carried support relation.
A vessel moving through water supplies another designed carrier.
Humans being borne completes the surah's repeated load-transfer analogy.

changed_reading.before: The servant is only the terminal recipient of spirit.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the servant is a relay-bearing surface: as throne and humans are carried by supports, spirit is placed on a servant so warning can be carried onward.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because رَفِيعُ normally signals elevation, not release from chains. The focus inventory nevertheless includes lifting a prisoner's fetter, and 40:71 supplies literal collars, linked chains, and dragging; downstream prose should retain it only as a qualified counterimage of enabled warning versus final coercion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَفِيعُ ... يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ ... عَلَىٰ ... عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ

activation_trace.role: A cord that lifts a prisoner's fetter supplies the odd but explicit release image.
A collar binding a limb supplies the final scene's bodily constraint.
Connected links make the constraint continuous rather than momentary.
Dragging and extension oppose the chosen servant's enabled movement into warning.

changed_reading.before: رَفِيعُ contributes only height and rank.
changed_reading.after: At the exploratory edge, divine elevation carries a faint counterimage of lifting constraint so a servant can transmit warning before refusal hardens into chained, externally compelled movement.

strongest_changes: The ل ق ي repetition became a temporal mechanism: present casting prepares future face-to-face exposure and account.
The static درجات hierarchy reopened as the measured life stages through which a finite servant moves before the meeting.
Divine height became outgoing, unseizable agency when contrasted with Pharaoh's failed engineered ascent.
Warning became an answerable pre-encounter communication window, while the chosen servant category expanded toward an unexpected concealed insider.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly reversed the focus ayah's vectors: book and provision descend, Pharaoh tries to ascend, a servant returns his affair in trust, carriers relay loads, and late voices fail. Those reversals made the compact focus ayah read as a governed transmission system rather than a list of titles.
remaining_uncertainties: The provision and growth model for ٱلرُّوحَ may be only an ecological analogy; textual revelation remains the cleaner reading.
The concealed believer exemplifies open servant-selection socially, but the packet does not say that he directly received the spirit.
The reciprocal affair model depends on holding command and affair senses of ء م ر together; they may remain distinct.
Carrier and lifted-fetter readings are deliberately contained material analogies, not proposed lexical translations.
